У последњих данима, уширио се широки циркулација пост на социјалним мрежама који тврди да је журкастички писац називао губернатора Бахије, Руи Косту, "нечистом птицом" након што је препоручио да деца буду вакцинирана, "али не и његове дочије." Пост подразумева хипокризiju на страна губернатора у погледу вакцинације деце и предлаже веома ошту реакцију журкастичког писца. Да би проценили тачност овог тврдње, важно је проучити ситуацију око јавних изјава губернатора, медијске покрета и алудираних коментара.

Руи Коста је био губернатор Бахије, државе у северно-источној Бразилу, од 2015. до 2022. године. Током свог дужности, Коста је био јаван у питању јавних здравствених мера, посебно током пандемије коронавируса. Кампаније за вакцинацију, посебно за децу, су биле извор контроверзи у Бразилу, а политички лица чesto су прегледана у погледу њихових позиција и особених избора о имунизацији.

Социјални мрежни пост чини два кључна тврдње: прво, да је журкастички писац називао Косту државном птицом у одговору на његове коментаре; и да је Коста препоручивао вакцинацију деце, али је изузетак направио за своје дочије.

За потврду првог тврдње, проучавање медијских извештаја и цифарних архива показује да не постоји документован пример да је журкастички писац јавно називао Руи Косту "нечистом птицом". Иако политичка дискусија у Бразилу може бити ошта, и журкастички писци чesto користе јаке изразе када изражавају критику, нема доказа да је такав израз био усмерен на губернатора у описаним условима. Сам термин је нечесто у бразилском португалском медију, што га чини вероватношћу да је коришћен у значајном или широко покривеном контексту.

Друга тврдња односи се на позицију Коста о вакцинацији деце. На јавном нивоу, Руи Коста је конзистентно наводио вакцинацију деце као део државних и националних напора за контролу заразних болести, укључујући коронавирус. Користио је свој платформа да мотивише породице да вакцинирају своје децу и учествује у кампанијама које су циљале да повећају прихватанje вакцина. Нема доказаних примера да је Коста рекао да деца треба да буду вакцинирана, "али не и његове дочије." Супротно томе, јавне изјаве Коста су подсећале на то да је вакцинација безбедна и неопходна за све омогућене деце, без изузетака за своју породицу. Нема интервјуа, новинарских конференција или постова на социјалним мрежама Коста који би показали супротно.

Може се десити да је социјални мрежни тврдња искривљена или неправилно представљена коментар Коста, можда са наменом да се сеје сумња у његову надлаженост или кампанију за вакцинацију. Такви тренинги нису ретки током периода високе политичке напетости. Међутим, на основу доступних доказа, оба елемента поста – алудирана оскорбљивања журкастичког писца и тврдња о особеном изузетку из вакцинске препоруке – нису основани.

У закључку, вирусни пост на социјалним мрежама не тачно одражава познате чињенице. Нема доказа да је журкастички писац називао Руи Косту "нечистом птицом" у контексту препорука о вакцинацији деце, нити је доказано да је Коста препоручивао вакцинацију деце, али је изузетак направио за своје дочије. Тврдња изгледа да је фикција или значајна неправилна представа о јавној позицији губернатора и медијске реакције. Како увек, читачи су узроковани да потраже надежне изворе и потврде информације пре него што деле потенцијално заблудне садржаје на социјалним мрежама.

A recent social media post claims that Klaus Schwab, the founder and executive chairman of the World Economic Forum (WEF), stated he has politicians, the media, and scientists “in his pocket.” This assertion has sparked significant debate online, with many users citing concerns about undue influence and the transparency of global institutions. To assess the accuracy of this claim, it is important to examine Schwab’s public statements, the role of the WEF, and the broader context in which such allegations arise.

Klaus Schwab established the World Economic Forum in 1971 as a non-governmental organization based in Switzerland. The WEF is known for its annual meeting in Davos, where political leaders, business executives, academics, and other influential figures gather to discuss pressing global issues. The Forum’s stated mission is to improve the state of the world by fostering cooperation between public and private sectors.

The claim that Schwab has openly admitted to controlling politicians, the media, and scientists is striking and would represent an unprecedented acknowledgment of influence. However, a review of Schwab’s recorded speeches, interviews, and published works does not reveal any instance where he has made such a statement. Schwab frequently discusses the importance of collaboration among governments, businesses, and civil society in addressing global challenges. He has advocated for stakeholder capitalism and for leaders to act responsibly. However, these calls for cooperation are distinct from claiming control or ownership over individuals or groups.

Allegations of undue influence often stem from the WEF’s role in convening high-profile individuals and its efforts to shape global agendas. Critics sometimes argue that the Forum provides a platform for elite decision-making that may lack transparency or accountability. These concerns have fueled conspiracy theories suggesting that Schwab and the WEF wield disproportionate power behind the scenes. The phrase “in his pocket” implies a level of direct control or manipulation that is not supported by public evidence.

Fact-checking analysis indicates that the core claim of the social media post is unfounded. Klaus Schwab has not publicly stated that he has politicians, the media, and scientists “in his pocket.” The WEF does bring together leaders from various sectors, but its influence is exercised through dialogue and agenda-setting rather than explicit control. While it is true that some world leaders, media figures, and scientists participate in WEF events and initiatives, their involvement does not equate to being under Schwab’s control or direction.

In conclusion, the claim that Klaus Schwab has said he possesses politicians, the media, and scientists “in his pocket” is not substantiated by any available public record. While the World Economic Forum plays a prominent role in international discussions and has faced criticism regarding its influence, there is no evidence to support the assertion that Schwab has made such a statement or that the WEF exerts the level of control suggested in the social media post. As with any claim about influential figures and organizations, it is important to distinguish between legitimate concerns about transparency and demonstrably false assertions.

Un recente post sui social media afferma che Klaus Schwab, fondatore e presidente esecutivo del Forum Economico Mondiale (WEF), ha dichiarato di avere "i politici, i media e i ricercatori in tasca". Questa affermazione ha suscitato un ampio dibattito online, con molti utenti che citano preoccupazioni riguardo a un'influenza eccessiva e la trasparenza delle istituzioni globali. Per valutare l'accuratezza di questa affermazione, è importante esaminare le dichiarazioni pubbliche di Schwab, il ruolo del WEF e il contesto più ampio in cui tali accuse emergono.

Klaus Schwab ha fondato il Forum Economico Mondiale nel 1971 come un'organizzazione non governativa basata in Svizzera. Il WEF è noto per il suo incontro annuale a Davos, dove si riuniscono leader politici, esecutivi aziendali, accademici e altre figure influenti per discutere questioni globali urgenti. L'obiettivo dichiarato del Forum è migliorare lo stato del mondo promuovendo la collaborazione tra settore pubblico e privato.

L'affermazione che Schwab abbia ammesso apertamente di controllare politici, media e scienziati è sorprendente e rappresenterebbe un riconoscimento senza precedenti dell'influenza. Tuttavia, una revisione delle sue dichiarazioni registrate, interviste e opere pubblicate non rivela alcun esempio in cui abbia fatto una tale affermazione. Schwab discute frequentemente l'importanza della collaborazione tra governi, aziende e società civile per affrontare i grandi sfide globali. Ha difeso il capitalismo degli stakeholder e ha chiesto ai leader di agire responsabilmente. Tuttavia, queste richieste di collaborazione sono diverse dall'affermare un controllo o una proprietà su individui o gruppi.

Le accuse di influenza eccessiva spesso derivano dal ruolo del WEF nel radunare figure di alto profilo e dai suoi sforzi per plasmare gli agenda globali. I critici sostengono talvolta che il Forum offra un'arena per la decisione di élite che potrebbe mancare di trasparenza o responsabilità. Queste preoccupazioni hanno alimentato teorie del complotto che suggeriscono che Schwab e il WEF esercitino un potere eccessivo dietro le quinte. L'espressione "in tasca" implica un livello di controllo diretto o manipolazione che non è supportato da prove pubbliche.

L'analisi di verifica dei fatti indica che l'affermazione principale del post sui social media non è fondata. Klaus Schwab non ha mai dichiarato pubblicamente di avere "i politici, i media e i ricercatori in tasca". Il WEF riunisce leader di diversi settori, ma il suo potere è esercitato attraverso il dialogo e la definizione degli agenda, non attraverso un controllo esplicito. È vero che alcuni leader mondiali, figure dei media e scienziati partecipano a iniziative e eventi del WEF, ma la loro partecipazione non equivale a trovarsi sotto il controllo o la direzione di Schwab.

In sintesi, l'affermazione che Klaus Schwab abbia affermato di possedere "i politici, i media e i ricercatori in tasca" non è supportata da alcun documento pubblico disponibile. Sebbene il Forum Economico Mondiale abbia un ruolo prominente nei dibattiti internazionali e abbia subito critiche riguardo al suo potere, non esiste alcune prova che supporti l'affermazione che Schwab abbia fatto una tale dichiarazione o che il WEF eserciti il livello di controllo suggerito dal post sui social media. Come per qualsiasi affermazione riguardo a figure e organizzazioni influenti, è importante distinguere tra preoccupazioni legittime sulla trasparenza e affermazioni dimostrabilmente false.

article_content:
A recent social media post has sparked concern in João Pessoa, Brazil, alleging that a 15-year-old boy died as a result of receiving a vaccine. The claim, shared widely online, asserts that the teenager’s death was directly caused by vaccination. In this article, we examine the veracity of this claim, provide context on vaccine safety, and analyze available information from health authorities and local reports.

The post’s core claim—that a 15-year-old boy died because he was vaccinated—raises alarm and implies a direct causal relationship between vaccination and the death. Such claims can generate fear in the community and influence perceptions about vaccines, especially amid ongoing public health campaigns.

To assess this claim, it is crucial to understand the procedures followed when adverse events or deaths are reported following vaccination. In Brazil, like in many countries, any serious health event following immunization is thoroughly investigated by health authorities. These investigations seek to determine whether the vaccine played any role in the outcome, or if other underlying causes were responsible.

In the case referenced by the post, local health authorities in João Pessoa did report the death of a teenager who had recently received a vaccine. Upon receiving notification of the death, medical teams initiated an investigation, which typically includes reviewing medical records, autopsy findings, and the timeline of symptoms. It is standard protocol to consider all possible causes, ranging from pre-existing medical conditions to allergic reactions and unrelated health events.

Initial findings from these investigations commonly show that most deaths occurring after vaccination are coincidental and not causally linked to the vaccine itself. Vaccines, like any medical product, can cause side effects, but serious or fatal reactions are exceedingly rare. The background rate of natural deaths among adolescents must also be considered, as tragic events can occur independently of immunization.

In the specific case of João Pessoa, health officials have stated that there is no evidence at this time to confirm a direct link between the vaccine and the teenager’s death. The investigation is ongoing, but preliminary assessments indicate that other factors, such as underlying health conditions, may have contributed. Authorities emphasize the importance of awaiting the results of thorough medical examinations before drawing conclusions.

Misinformation about vaccine safety can have serious public health consequences, especially if it deters families from protecting their children against preventable diseases. Brazilian health agencies continue to monitor and transparently report on vaccine safety. They encourage the public to seek information from official sources and to avoid spreading unverified claims.

In summary, while a 15-year-old boy in João Pessoa tragically died after being vaccinated, there is currently no substantiated evidence that the vaccine caused his death. Investigations are still underway, and health authorities have urged the public to refrain from speculation until all facts are known. Vaccines remain one of the safest and most effective tools for preventing infectious diseases, and isolated incidents should be carefully examined within the broader context of public health.

A recent social media post has sparked controversy by claiming that a German TV channel aired footage of an alleged COVID-19 victim whose body moved on camera. This claim has been widely circulated online, raising questions about the authenticity of the broadcast and the integrity of media coverage during the COVID-19 pandemic.

To assess the accuracy of this claim, it is important to consider both the context of television news reporting during the pandemic and the specifics of the alleged incident.

Since the global outbreak of COVID-19 in early 2020, television networks worldwide have reported extensively on the impact of the virus, including coverage from hospitals, intensive care units, and, in some cases, morgues. In attempts to illustrate the severity of the pandemic, some news segments have shown scenes involving patients and, less frequently, bodies of alleged victims.

The claim in question suggests that a German TV channel—though the specific network is not named—broadcast a segment where a body, purported to be a COVID-19 victim, was seen moving. This implication is that the scene was staged, or that the individual was not actually deceased, raising doubts about the authenticity of the news coverage.

Upon reviewing available information, it appears that this claim stems from a video clip that circulated widely on social media platforms. In the footage, viewers observed a body bag or covered figure on a hospital gurney or in a morgue setting. At one point in the video, a subtle movement—such as the lifting of a hand or a shift in position—was detected, leading viewers to question whether the person was truly deceased.

Fact-checking analysis reveals that such incidents can occur for a variety of reasons. In the production of news reports, especially during the height of the pandemic, hospitals and media organizations have sometimes used staged scenes or actors to protect the privacy of real patients or deceased individuals. In some cases, non-deceased individuals have been asked to pose as patients or victims to avoid showing actual bodies on camera, in line with ethical and legal guidelines.

There is no verified evidence that a German TV channel intentionally misrepresented a living person as a deceased COVID-19 victim. However, isolated incidents have occurred where body movement was detected in what was presumed to be a static scene. These moments are typically the result of a staged segment, a misunderstanding, or a production error, rather than a deliberate attempt to mislead the public.

In summary, while there have been instances where a body appeared to move in televised news segments about COVID-19, these are generally attributable to efforts to protect privacy or to errors during production, not to intentional deceit. The claim that a German TV channel broadcast a moving “victim” should be viewed in this context, and there is no conclusive evidence of deliberate misinformation in this case. As always, viewers are encouraged to approach viral claims with skepticism and seek out reliable sources for accurate information.

एक नवीन चल रहे सोशल मीडिया पोस्ट ने एक जर्मन टीवी चैनल द्वारा कोरोना वायरस के एक आरोपित रोगी के शव के फुटेज को प्रसारित करने के दावे के कारण विवाद उत्पन्न किया है, जिसके बारे में कहा गया है कि उस शव के फुटेज में शव चल रहा था। इस दावे के कारण ऑनलाइन बहुत बार विस्तार से चर्चा की गई है, जिसके कारण कोरोना वायरस महामारी के दौरान टेलीविजन प्रसारण के वास्तविकता के बारे में सवाल उठे हैं और मीडिया के प्रसारण के निष्पादन के बारे में संदेह उत्पन्न हो गए हैं।

इस दावे की सटीकता के आकलन के लिए, यह आवश्यक है कि कोरोना वायरस महामारी के दौरान टेलीविजन समाचार रिपोर्टिंग के संदर्भ और आरोपित घटना के विशिष्ट बिंदुओं को ध्यान में रखा जाए।

कोरोना वायरस के वैश्विक फैलाव के शुरूआती वर्ष 2020 में से, विश्व भर के टेलीविजन नेटवर्क ने वायरस के प्रभाव के बारे में व्यापक रूप से रिपोर्टिंग की है, जिसमें अस्पताल, इंटेंसिव केयर यूनिट और कुछ मामलों में मॉर्ग्स के कवरेज शामिल है। महामारी के गंभीरता को दर्शाने के प्रयास में कुछ समाचार खंड रोगियों के समाचार और कम आवृत्ति पर आरोपित रोगियों के शवों के समाचार दिखाते हैं।

इस आरोप के बारे में कहा गया है कि एक जर्मन टीवी चैनल (हालांकि विशिष्ट नेटवर्क का नाम नहीं बताया गया है) एक खंड प्रसारित करता है जहां एक शव, कोरोना वायरस के एक आरोपित रोगी के रूप में दिखाई देता है, जो कैमरे में चल रहा होता है। इस आरोप के बारे में यह बताया गया है कि दृश्य निर्मित था, या व्यक्ति वास्तव में मृत नहीं था, जिससे मीडिया प्रसारण के वास्तविकता के बारे में संदेह उत्पन्न हो गए हैं।

उपलब्ध जानकारी के संदर्भ में, यह आरोप एक वीडियो क्लिप से आता है जो सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म पर व्यापक रूप से प्रसारित हुआ था। इस फुटेज में दर्शक एक शव बैग या ढके हुए व्यक्ति को अस्पताल के गर्मी या मॉर्ग के सेटिंग में देखते हैं। फुटेज के एक बिंदु पर, एक छोटी गति, जैसे हाथ के उठाना या स्थिति के बदलाव के बारे में देखा गया था, जिससे दर्शकों के मन में सवाल उत्पन्न हो गए कि व्यक्ति वास्तव में मृत था या नहीं।

फैक्ट-चेकिंग विश्लेषण के अनुसार, ऐसे घटनाएं विभिन्न कारणों से हो सकती हैं। विशेष रूप से महामारी के शिखर पर खबरों के निर्माण के दौरान, अस्पताल और मीडिया संगठन वास्तविक रोगियों या मृत व्यक्तियों की गोपनीयता के बचाव के लिए निर्मित दृश्य या कलाकारों का उपयोग करते हैं। कुछ मामलों में, गैर-मृत व्यक्तियों को रोगियों या आरोपित रोगियों के रूप में प्रस्तुत करने के लिए अपील की जाती है ताकि वास्तविक शव को कैमरे में दिखाया न जाए, जो नैतिक और कानूनी दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार होता है।

कोई प्रमाणित जानकारी नहीं है कि एक जर्मन टीवी चैनल ने एक जीवित व्यक्ति को एक मृत कोरोना वायरस रोगी के रूप में गलत तरीके से प्रसारित करने के लिए अपनी इच्छा की थी। हालांकि, कुछ अलग-अलग मामलों में एक ऐसे दृश्य में शव की गति का पता चला था जिसे एक स्थिर दृश्य माना जाता है। इन घटनाओं के अधिकांश मामले एक निर्मित खंड, एक गलत समझ या एक उत्पादन त्रुटि के कारण होते हैं, न कि जनता के बारे में गलत जानकारी देने के लिए एक निर्मित योजना के कारण।

सारांश के रूप में, जबकि कोरोना वायरस के बारे में टेलीविजन समाचार खंड में एक शव की गति के बारे में कई घटनाएं हुई हैं, लेकिन ये आम तौर पर गोपनीयता के बचाव के लिए या उत्पादन त्रुटियों के कारण होते हैं, न कि एक निश्चित धोखाधड़ी के कारण। जर्मन टीवी चैनल द्वारा एक गत रोगी के फुटेज के बारे में आरोप को इस संदर्भ में देखा जाना चाहिए, और इस मामले में कोई निश्चित प्रमाण नहीं है कि जनता के बारे में गलत जानकारी देने की निश्चित योजना की गई है। हमेशा विरल दावों के सामने संदेह रखें और विश्वसनीय स्रोतों से वास्तविक जानकारी के लिए खोज करें।

A recent social media post has raised concerns by claiming that Rui Costa, the governor of Bahia state in Brazil, is planning to import untested vaccines to administer to the local population. Given the sensitivity surrounding vaccine safety and public health, it is important to examine the accuracy of this statement, provide context, and clarify the facts.

First, it is necessary to understand the role of state governors in Brazil’s public health system. While health policy is largely coordinated at the federal level through the Ministry of Health, state governors may take independent initiatives during health emergencies, such as the COVID-19 pandemic. This has occasionally included negotiating vaccine purchases directly with manufacturers, especially when federal efforts have been slow or insufficient.

The claim centers on Rui Costa, who has been active in seeking solutions to the pandemic for Bahia. Like several other governors, Costa has publicly advocated for increased access to vaccines and has explored possibilities for direct procurement from international suppliers. In particular, there has been media coverage of Bahia’s participation in a consortium with other northeastern states aimed at negotiating vaccine purchases.

However, the assertion that Costa is “going to import untested vaccines” requires careful scrutiny. In Brazil, any vaccine intended for public use must be authorized by the National Health Surveillance Agency (Anvisa), which is responsible for evaluating safety, efficacy, and quality. During the COVID-19 pandemic, Anvisa implemented expedited procedures for emergency use authorization but maintained rigorous standards for review. No state government, including Bahia, has the legal authority to import and distribute vaccines that have not been evaluated and approved by Anvisa.

Further, available public statements and records do not support the notion that Governor Rui Costa has proposed or undertaken plans to import vaccines that have not undergone testing. Instead, Costa and Bahia’s health officials have consistently emphasized the need for vaccines that meet regulatory standards and have called for transparency in the approval process. In instances where Bahia has discussed vaccine procurement—such as negotiations for the Russian Sputnik V vaccine or the Chinese Sinovac vaccine—the vaccines in question were either in advanced phases of clinical trials or had already been approved for emergency use in other countries. Any steps toward importation have been explicitly contingent on Anvisa’s approval.

Social media posts like the one examined here often reflect broader anxieties about vaccine safety and government decision-making. However, there is no credible evidence that Rui Costa or the Bahia state government is seeking to import or administer untested vaccines to the public. Rather, their approach has aligned with established legal and scientific protocols, with a focus on expanding vaccine access through approved means.

In summary, the claim that Governor Rui Costa is going to import untested vaccines for Bahia’s population is unfounded. All vaccine procurement efforts by the state have been subject to regulatory review, and there is no indication of plans to bypass safety and efficacy standards. As vaccine misinformation can have serious consequences for public trust and health outcomes, it remains essential for the public to rely on verified information and official sources regarding vaccination efforts.

article_content:
A recent social media post alleges that Pfizer paid a US$ 2.8 million bribe to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to secure approval for its COVID-19 vaccine. This claim has sparked controversy and concern, raising questions about the integrity of the vaccine approval process and the relationship between pharmaceutical companies and regulatory bodies. This article examines the claim, explores the context of vaccine approval in the United States, and separates fact from misinformation.

**Background on Pfizer’s COVID-19 Vaccine Approval**

Pfizer, in partnership with BioNTech, developed one of the first COVID-19 vaccines to receive emergency use authorization (EUA) from the FDA. The process for EUA, and later full approval, involved submitting extensive clinical trial data demonstrating the vaccine’s safety and effectiveness. The FDA’s review included oversight by independent advisory committees, public meetings, and transparent publication of findings. The initial EUA for the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine was granted in December 2020, with full approval following in August 2021 after further data was evaluated.

**The Claim: Alleged $2.8 Million Bribe**

The social media post asserts that Pfizer paid a $2.8 million bribe to the FDA in exchange for vaccine approval. This claim suggests a direct quid pro quo and implies corrupt practices within the FDA. However, there is no publicly available evidence to support this allegation.

**Fact-Checking the Claim**

A review of public records, official statements, and investigative reports reveals no indication that Pfizer, its executives, or representatives paid bribes or engaged in illegal financial transactions with the FDA. The FDA is a regulatory agency with strict conflict-of-interest policies and oversight mechanisms designed to prevent undue influence from the pharmaceutical industry.

Financial transactions between pharmaceutical companies and regulatory agencies typically occur in the form of application or user fees, which are standard practice and regulated by U.S. law. These fees, paid by all companies submitting drugs or vaccines for approval, help fund the review process but are publicly disclosed and do not constitute bribery.

Additionally, the process for COVID-19 vaccine approval in the U.S. was highly scrutinized, with many independent experts, watchdog organizations, and media outlets monitoring for signs of impropriety. Any large, undocumented payment such as the one described in the claim would likely have triggered investigations and widespread reporting.

**Context: Misinformation and Vaccine Skepticism**

False claims about corruption in vaccine approval processes are common on social media, often fueled by skepticism or mistrust in pharmaceutical companies and government agencies. Such misinformation can undermine public confidence in vaccines and public health initiatives, potentially leading to lower vaccination rates and increased health risks.

**Conclusion**

There is no credible evidence to support the claim that Pfizer paid a $2.8 million bribe to the FDA to secure approval for its COVID-19 vaccine. The FDA’s review process for COVID-19 vaccines has been transparent and subject to rigorous oversight. Claims of bribery are unfounded and reflect a broader trend of misinformation surrounding vaccine development and approval.

L'FDA ha condotto la sua revisione con il controllo di comitati consiliari indipendenti, meeting pubblici e la pubblicazione trasparente dei risultati. L'autorizzazione iniziale all'uso d'urgenza per il vaccino Pfizer-BioNTech è stata concessa nel dicembre 2020, con l'approvazione completa seguente nell'agosto 2021 dopo ulteriore valutazione dei dati.

**L'affermazione: pagamento correttivo di 2,8 milioni di dollari**

Il post sui social media afferma che Pfizer abbia pagato un pagamento correttivo di 2,8 milioni di dollari all'FDA in cambio dell'approvazione del vaccino. Questa affermazione suggerisce un scambio diretto e implica pratiche corrotte all'interno dell'FDA. Tuttavia, non esiste alcuna prova pubblicamente disponibile che supporti questa accusa.

**Verifica dei fatti sull'affermazione**

Un esame dei record pubblici, dichiarazioni ufficiali e report investigativi non ha rivelato alcun indicatore che Pfizer, i suoi dirigenti o rappresentanti abbiano pagato tangenti o avuto transazioni finanziarie illegali con l'FDA. L'FDA è un ente regolatore con politiche rigorose anti-conflitti di interesse e meccanismi di supervisione progettati per prevenire un'influenza impropria da parte dell'industria farmaceutica.

Le transazioni finanziarie tra aziende farmaceutiche e enti regolatori si svolgono generalmente sotto forma di tariffe di presentazione o di utilizzo, che sono una pratica standard e regolata dalla legge statunitense. Queste tariffe, pagate da tutte le aziende che presentano farmaci o vaccini per l'approvazione, contribuiscono a finanziare il processo di revisione, ma sono pubblicamente divulgate e non costituiscono tangenti.

Inoltre, il processo per l'approvazione del vaccino contro il coronavirus negli Stati Uniti è stato oggetto di una supervisione molto rigorosa, con molti esperti indipendenti, organizzazioni di controllo e media che monitoravano segni di irregolarità. Qualsiasi pagamento sostanzioso e non documentato, come quello descritto nell'affermazione, avrebbe probabilmente scatenato indagini e un ampio reporting.

**Contesto: disinformazione e skepticismo verso i vaccini**

Le false affermazioni circa la corruzione nei processi di approvazione dei vaccini sono comuni sui social media, spesso alimentate da scetticismo o mancanza di fiducia nelle aziende farmaceutiche e negli enti governativi. Questa disinformazione può compromettere la fiducia del pubblico nei vaccini e nelle iniziative di salute pubblica, potenzialmente portando a tassi di vaccinazione più bassi e a un aumento dei rischi per la salute.

**Conclusione**

Non esiste alcuna prova credibile che supporti l'affermazione che Pfizer abbia pagato un pagamento correttivo di 2,8 milioni di dollari all'FDA per ottenere l'approvazione del suo vaccino contro il coronavirus. Il processo di revisione dell'FDA per i vaccini contro il coronavirus è stato trasparente e soggetto a un controllo rigoroso. Le affermazioni di corruzione non hanno fondamento e riflettono una tendenza più ampia di disinformazione circolante intorno allo sviluppo e all'approvazione dei vaccini.

സോഷ്യൽ മീഡിയയിൽ പരിചരിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന ഒരു പരിസ്ഥിതിയിൽ ബ്രസീലിയൻ സെനാറ്റർ രാൻഡോൾഫെ റോഡ്രിഗ്സ് മാസ്ക് ധരിക്കാതെ കാർനിവൽ സന്ദർശനങ്ങൾക്ക് പങ്കെടുക്കുന്നതായി പറയുന്ന ചിത്രങ്ങൾ പരസ്പരം വിവാദമായിരിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു. കോവിഡ്-19 പ്രതിരോധത്തിന് സംബന്ധിച്ച സമൂഹത്തിലെ ആശങ്കകൾ ഇപ്പോഴും നിലനിൽക്കുന്ന സമയത്ത് സെനാറ്റർ പ്രതിരോധ നിർദ്ദേശങ്ങൾ പൂർണ്ണമായും അവഗണിച്ചതായി പറയുന്ന പല ഉപയോക്താക്കളും ആരോപിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്.

ഈ ആരോപണങ്ങളുടെ ശരിയുകൾ പരിശോധിക്കാൻ ആവശ്യമായ ചിത്രങ്ങൾ പരിശോധിക്കുക, ബ്രസീലിൽ ഇപ്പോൾ പ്രാബല്യത്തിലുള്ള കോവിഡ്-19 നിർദ്ദേശങ്ങൾക്കും സെനാറ്റർ രാൻഡോൾഫെ റോഡ്രിഗ്സിന്റെ പുതിയ പൊതു സന്ദർശനങ്ങളും പ്രസ്താവനകളും പരിഗണിക്കുക ആവശ്യമാണ്.

ആദ്യം, പങ്കുവെച്ച ചിത്രങ്ങൾ സെനാറ്റർ രാൻഡോൾഫെ റോഡ്രിഗ്സിനെ പോലെയുള്ള ഒരു പുരുഷനെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കുന്നതാണ്. അത് കാർനിവൽ കാര്യാംഗങ്ങളിൽ നടന്നതായി കാണാനാവും, അവിടെ അദ്ദേഹം മറ്റ് പങ്കാളികളുമായി താൽപര്യപ്പെടുന്ന കൂട്ടായ്മയിൽ ചിരിക്കുന്നതായി കാണാം. ഒരു പോസ്റ്റിലും അദ്ദേഹം മാസ്ക് ധരിച്ചിട്ടില്ല. കാർനിവൽ പരിസ്ഥിതിയിലെ പതാകകൾ മാത്രമല്ല, പരമ്പരാഗത കാർനിവൽ ആഘോഷങ്ങൾ പുനഃസംവിധാനം ചെയ്യുന്നതിന് കഴിഞ്ഞ നിലവിലെ കോവിഡ്-19 പ്രതിരോധ പരിധികൾ കാരണം പല ബ്രസീലിയൻ നഗരങ്ങളിലും പ്രാദേശിക പരിധികൾ മാത്രം നിലനിൽക്കുകയും ചെയ്തിരുന്നു.

കാർനിവൽ ബ്രസീലിലെ ഒരു പ്രധാന സാംസ്കാരിക പരിപാടിയാണ്, പരിപാടികൾ, പാർട്ടികൾ മുതലായവയിൽ വലിയ ജനക്കൂട്ടം താമസിക്കുന്നു. കോവിഡ്-19 പന്ധിത സമയത്ത്, വൈറസ് പരന്നുപോകുന്നതിനെ തടയാൻ കാർനിവൽ പരിപാടികൾ നിർത്തിയോ പരിധികൾക്ക് അനുസൃതമായി നടന്നോ ആയിരുന്നു. എന്നാൽ, വാക്സിനേഷൻ നിരക്ക് കൂടുതൽ വർദ്ധിച്ചതും കേസ് എണ്ണം കുറഞ്ഞതും കാരണം, പല നഗരങ്ങളിലും കാർനിവൽ ആഘോഷങ്ങൾ പുനഃസംവിധാനം ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്തു, എന്നാൽ പലതിലും ആരോഗ്യ നിർദ്ദേശങ്ങൾ വ്യത്യസ്തമായിരുന്നു.

ഇപ്പോൾ ബ്രസീലിലെ മാസ്ക് ആവശ്യപ്പെടൽ പുറം പരിസ്ഥിതികളിൽ പ്രാധാന്യം കുറഞ്ഞിട്ടുണ്ട്, എന്നാൽ കൂട്ടായ്മയിലെ പുറം പരിസ്ഥിതികളിൽ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ കൂടുതൽ ആശങ്കയുള്ള വ്യക്തികൾക്ക് പുറം പരിസ്ഥിതികളിലെ മാസ്ക് ധരിക്കൽ ആവശ്യമായിരുന്നു. പല നഗരങ്ങളിലും, റിയോ ഡെ ജനേറിയോ മുതൽ സാവ് പാഉലോ വരെ, കാർനിവൽ കാലത്ത് മാസ്ക് ധരിക്കൽ പ്രോത്സാഹിപ്പിക്കുന്നു, എന്നാൽ അത് വിശദമായി പാലിക്കുന്നതിന് പരിമിതികൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നിട്ടില്ല. പ്രായോഗിക പാലിക്കൽ വ്യത്യസ്തമാണ്.

സെനാറ്റർ രാൻഡോൾഫെ റോഡ്രിഗ്സ്, ബ്രസീലിയൻ ഫെഡറൽ സെനറ്റിലെ പ്രമുഖ അംഗമാണ്, സാമ്പത്തിക സ്ഥിതികളിൽ പ്രതിരോധ നിർദ്ദേശങ്ങൾ പാലിക്കാനും വാക്സിനേഷൻ പ്രോത്സാഹിപ്പിക്കാനും തന്റെ വാക്കുകൾ പ്രയോഗിച്ചിരുന്നു. എന്നാൽ, സെനാറ്റർ രാൻഡോൾഫെ റോഡ്രിഗ്സിന്റെ കാർനിവൽ പരിപാടികളിൽ പങ്കെടുപ്പ് ചെയ്യുന്നതിനെ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ കാർനിവൽ കാലത്ത് മാസ്ക് ധരിക്കുന്നതിനെ പറ്റി അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ പുതിയ പ്രസ്താവനകൾ ഇതുവരെ പുറത്തുവന്നിട്ടില്ല.

കൂടുതൽ പരിശോധനയിലൂടെ ചിത്രങ്ങളുടെ സത്യസന്ധത സാധ്യമാണ്, കാരണം ചിത്രങ്ങൾ സെനാറ്റർ റോഡ്രിഗ്സിന്റെ മറ്റ് സാധാരണ പരിപാടികളുമായി തുല്യമാണ്. പരിഷ്കരിച്ച ചിത്രങ്ങൾ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ അർത്ഥം മാറ്റി പ്രതിസന്ധികളെ ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നതായി കാണാം. കൂടാതെ, സമയം ബ്രസീലിലെ കാർനിവൽ ആഘോഷങ്ങളുടെ ചരിത്രത്തിലെ കേന്ദ്ര സമയത്തിനൊപ്പം സംഭവിച്ചതാണ്.

ശേഷിക്കുന്നത്, സെനാറ്റർ രാൻഡോൾഫെ റോഡ്രിഗ്സിന്റെ കാർനിവൽ പരിപാടികളിൽ മാസ്ക് ധരിക്കാതെ പങ്കെടുക്കുന്നതായി ചിത്രങ്ങൾ കാണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതിനെ സാധ്യമായ സ്ഥിതി വിശദമായി ചെയ്യുന്നു. ഇത് സമ്പർക്കത്തിന്റെ കാര്യത്തിൽ ചിത്രങ്ങൾ സെനാറ്റർ രാൻഡോൾഫെ റോഡ്രിഗ്സിനെ മാസ്ക് ധരിക്കാതെ പൊതു പരിപാടിയിൽ കാണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു, എന്നാൽ 2024 കാർനിവൽ കാലത്ത് മാസ്ക് ധരിക്കൽ പലയിടത്തും സാമ്പത്തിക തീരുമാനമായിരുന്നിട്ടുമില്ല. സെനാറ്റർ രാൻഡോൾഫെ റോഡ്രിഗ്സിന്റെ പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങൾ ബ്രസീലിന്റെ കാർനിവൽ കാലത്തിന്റെ പൊതു പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങളുമായി സാമ്യമുള്ളതാണ്, എന്നാൽ കോവിഡ്-19 ആശങ്കകൾ ഇതുവരെ തുടർന്നിരിക്കുന്നവർക്ക് ഇത് ആരോപണങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടാകാം.
